name: Horseshoe Canyon Ranch parking by the Trading Post (check-in, day-use fee)
basis: Ranch access text: dirt road south from Hwy 74 to a gate, then downhill to the Trading Post where all climbers must check in; parking is close to the climbing and camping (5-10 min approach). Only one mapped lot in the brief; named.mjs puts the Horseshoe Canyon Ranch Trading Company 0.02 km from it (West Campground 0.28 km), so match is by position.
